verdict.rationale: mParticle's own docs list a capability to "View and enforce your data quality" and "Ensure data quality", which points to first-party schema enforcement. However, the pack has only these headings, with no description of how violating events are handled. missing for 10: documented tracking plan or schema definition, specifics on flagging, blocking or quarantining violating events, details on preventing downstream corruption, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, a tracking plan or schema is enforced — violating events get flagged, blocked, or quarantined instead of silently corrupting downstream data

citations.quote: View and enforce your data quality
